title: RFC 3986 URI check: jscontact/jscalendar uri members in ContactCard and CalendarEvent /set
description: draft-atwood-jmap-updates-00 §7.1: URI-valued properties SHOULD hold RFC 3986 URIs (absolute unless the spec allows a relative reference; fragments allowed). Apply jmap_types::uri::check_uri (or check_uri_reference where the spec allows relative references) to: jscontact/jscalendar uri members in ContactCard and CalendarEvent /set (contacts, calendars servers), in crate-jmap-contacts-server, crate-jmap-calendars-server. Client-settable values: reject with invalidProperties naming the property on /set; server-set values: make sure the server only emits URIs (IRIs mapped per RFC 3987 §3.1). Audit table: docs/design/updates.md §13. Tests per property: a valid URI, a URI with a fragment, a relative reference, a value with a space, a raw non-ASCII IRI.
close_reason: JSContact/JSCalendar URI members checked on ContactCard and CalendarEvent /set and /copy (updates via jmap_server::patch_values_as_object, recurrenceOverrides PatchObjects expanded); 6 tests
